import sys

P = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    table = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                continue
            if i == 0:
                table[i][j] = (table[i][j - 1] + ((i + j) & 1)) % P
            else:
                table[i][j] = (table[i - 1][j] + table[i][j - 1] + ((i + j) & 1)) % P

    print(table[n][n])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
